name: dataproduct-mcp-11
description: Connect Cursor to a user-selected DataOS DataProduct MCP instance through OAuth. After /add-plugin or when tools are missing: ask the user in chat for their DataOS instance FQDN (hostname only, e.g. your-instance.instance.dataos.cloud; no https:// and no /mcp/api/v1). Tell them to save it in Customize → Plugins → DataProduct MCP → Configure, then call mcp_auth and re-check STATUS.md until the MCP server is running. fetch failed means the FQDN is missing, wrong, or unreachable.

DATAOS_INSTANCE_FQDN.title: DataOS instance FQDN
DATAOS_INSTANCE_FQDN.description: Hostname only, for example qaiks-070226.instance.dataos.cloud. Do not include https:// or /mcp/api/v1. Cursor builds https://<fqdn>/mcp/api/v1
